scope: prospective official9.2.5 Windows trial reference protocol; this task is minimal closure and registration, not B calibration

trial.numbering_boundary: standard C4=MIDI60; native trial mapping must be evidenced without opening validation notes

training.stage_policy: only authorized pilot first; no full corpus until pilot identity and prediction admission

controls.temperament: Flat, as documented strict octave ratio; observed partial identity not replaced by name
controls.retuning: Full rebuild recorded in full snapshot or explicitly unresolved and blocking
controls.lid: fully open, actual named/normalized value logged
controls.pickup: one fixed documented active microphone, other microphones off; stereo-power metrology, never call coherent downmix a central string
controls.gain: explicit dB and output gain recorded, no automatic normalization; reject clipped/floor dominated lines

pilot.purpose: prove traceable families and independent-partial prediction before high register

selection_change_from_v1.reason: published trial D#5 exclusion, standard MIDI mapping; choose an unviewed white-key pitch before rendering/inspecting new corpus, not from fit quality
selection_change_from_v1.restriction_numbering: published pitch names and standard C4=MIDI60 mapping; validate native naming/disable boundary without opening holdouts

controls.retuning: Full rebuild, not unknown tension change
controls.pickup: same known microphone with documented changed perspective/position fixed before validation, not selected for best spectral match
controls.session_and_seed: normal session time <=20min, recorded seed or deterministic repeat proof, no hidden-state inheritance

sealed_validation.policy: separate raw directory/manifest; do not inspect spectral metrics, select peaks, choose seeds, or tune on this set; one final evaluation; failure consumes holdout, next iteration registers new validation data

already_viewed_diagnostic_only.qualification: prior original/modified outputs and self-owned measurements remain viewed; source switch does not reset blindness; optional30 mute-boundary diagnostic is not calibration data

state_binding.required_before_any_pilot: separate immutable execution-state receipt: exact official producer version/preset/bank/FXP hash plus private storage isolation, control values/seed and actual restore counterexample
state_binding.opaque_or_unexposed_fields: use normal complete snapshot plus documented behavior; never infer hidden state from label or exposed controls alone
state_binding.unresolved_capability: block training, not prefs-only fallback or guessed controls

meter_preflight.unresolved_case: two 0.4 Hz spaced lines under 3.72 s Hann; no center-string or physical-B admission regardless of small fit residual

requirements: traceable same-string family or explicit only-effective-output label
new observations and peak assignments independent of candidate table
window/repeat uncertainty estimates; no clip/floor-dominated peaks
physical_admission.C7_three_partial_policy: diagnostic candidate only; no default B anchor from three mixed output peaks
physical_admission.fitting_minimum: use >=3 identified training partials and >=2 untouched partials for prediction; re-identify heldout peaks without full-data nearest-peak assignments

acceptance_metrics.admitted_partial_prediction: RMS <=1 cent and max <=3 cents on independent partials/notes; estimator repeat/window spread <=1 cent for admitted stationary line; no tolerance relaxation after seeing outputs
acceptance_metrics.A4_audio: same identified line within 0.07 Hz for 400/440/480 Hz, ageing 0; mono mixed winner cannot substitute for line identity
acceptance_metrics.intervals: preselected 4:2 below A4 and 2:1 above A4; central interpolation exceptions documented; <=1 cent matching error outside interpolation band
acceptance_metrics.pitch_order: strict adjacent-note increase on 44.1/48 kHz; 8 kHz safety/degradation separate, never claim full-range accurate pitch
acceptance_metrics.Nyquist: finite bounded long audio; no active modeled oscillator beyond safe band; nonlinear alias residual separately observed
acceptance_metrics.block_rate_consistency: same-line frequency <=0.1 cent at 44.1/48 kHz; normalized spectrum and RMS shifts <=0.5 dB for same held-out condition; 512/257 sample delta <=2 24-bit PCM LSB when quantized
acceptance_metrics.B_stability: window/repeat relative B spread <=10% if B identifiable; failure means not admitted, not a forced table entry

threshold_qualification: pre-registered engineering criteria, not measured achievements or universal piano laws
unavailable_controlled_reference: retain current devpiano constants; preserve this registration, diagnose capability or register a new approved reference; do not force B or relax errors
